fusions.name: Spiked Back
fusions.desc: A quick blow with the spike on your weapon's back that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown From the Sleeve
fusions.desc: A hidden throw that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full 7-tile reach, and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Under the Apron
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds; enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Edge Then Weight
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
